title: Network Tuning (Gaming / Hitreg)
name: optimize-network-settings
description: Adjusts Windows TCP settings. It may not improve ping or hit registration and can behave differently by network.
deepDescription:
WHAT IT CHANGES
Changes Windows TCP heuristics, congestion control, RSS, ECN, timestamps, TCP Fast Open, and the custom initial congestion window. A restart may be needed.

HIT REGISTRATION
There is no universal Windows setting that guarantees better hit registration. Hitreg depends on the game and server, route, packet loss, jitter, and your connection. These TCP settings do not change a game's server tick rate or netcode, and may not help every ISP or game.

BEFORE APPLYING
Use a wired connection when possible and check in-game packet loss and latency. Undo restores generic Windows TCP defaults, which may differ from any custom values you previously had.
